'''Usma''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], and was widely acknowledged as one of the Order's most famous [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duelists]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. Usma was [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] a [[Usma's Padawan|Padawan]] in the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war, and the two were on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] when the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|attacked]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Lord Praven" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline" /> During the fighting, Usma engaged a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] by the name of [[Praven]] in a intense duel, and despite the Master's skill, Usma was struck down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in front of the Jedi's student. Praven spared Usma's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], telling her to seek him out after she had finished her training, and he dispatched her as well when the Jedi tracked him down [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="Lord Praven" />

==Behind the scenes==
Usma was mentioned in a codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Lord Praven" />
